# One run reports every malformed template name, not just the first.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error:
  GET /a F(reqest)
           ^^^^^^
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:22: unknown argument reqest; did you mean request?

  POST /b http.StatusCreatd G(ctx)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
$WORK/template.gohtml:2:21: invalid status code http.StatusCreatd: did you mean http.StatusCreated?
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /a F(reqest)" -}}a{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /b http.StatusCreatd G(ctx)" -}}b{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) F(_ context.Context) string { return "" }
func (T) G(_ context.Context) string { return "" }
